title: Using AI Agents to Automate Black-Box Audits of Personalization Algorithms at Scale
reasoning: The paper focuses on auditing personalization algorithms for social media platforms to detect amplification and demographic bias. While it utilizes a persona typology from Pew Research that includes a 'Faith and Flag Conservatives' category and classifies content based on 'moralized conflict', it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, theology, or ethical/moral frameworks themselves.
